primary_task: Turn a Notion spec into a Notion implementation plan page and linked task pages: search and fetch the spec, create the plan with notion-create-pages, create tasks in the task database and link them.

requirements.name: Notion (notion-search, notion-fetch)
requirements.evidence: "Locate the spec with `Notion:notion-search`, then fetch it with `Notion:notion-fetch`."
requirements.basis: "notion": "Notion connector (the user's workspace): notion-search, notion-fetch, notion-create-pages, notion-update-page, notion-create-database"

requirements.name: Notion (notion-create-pages, notion-update-page)
requirements.evidence: "Create a plan page with `Notion:notion-create-pages`" ; "create tasks with `Notion:notion-create-pages`" ; "keep status current with `Notion:notion-update-page`"
requirements.basis: "notion": "Notion connector (the user's workspace): notion-search, notion-fetch, notion-create-pages, notion-update-page, notion-create-database" ; grants: "notion_account"

requirements.name: writes_external (creating and updating pages in the user's Notion workspace)
requirements.evidence: "Create a plan page with `Notion:notion-create-pages`" ; "Create pages with `Notion:notion-create-pages` using the database's `data_source_id`."

requirements.name: codex CLI (codex mcp add / login)
requirements.evidence: "If any MCP call fails because Notion MCP is not connected, pause and set it up: codex mcp add notion --url https://mcp.notion.com/mcp" (only on failure)
requirements.basis: "bash": "... install packages from the open registries (... npm ...)" (codex is on npm, but mcp.notion.com is outside the allow-list; not needed because the Notion connector is listed)

blocking: other:writes_external (creating and updating pages in the user's Notion workspace)
notes: Two readings. Strict (taken): the manifest lists "writes_external" in forbid_effects, and the deliverable is new pages written into an external Notion workspace, so the core step is forbidden -> BLOCKED. Other reading: the manifest explicitly lists the Notion connector with notion-create-pages and notion-update-page and grants notion_account, which suggests writes through the listed connector are intended to be allowed; under that reading every hard requirement is available and the verdict is ACHIEVABLE. The codex MCP setup branch is only for a missing connector and does not apply.
